title: Style-Converter IR v1 (wire format)
description: Machine-checked contract for the IR JSON that the converter emits (out/tmpOutput.json) and the three runtime style engines consume. STRICT at the envelope (document / component / selector / media / property wrapper): unknown keys at these levels are a schema violation. PERMISSIVE at property-data leaves: the 550-property value surface varies per property and is documented (not enforced) in schema/spec/02-values.md; leaf strictness arrives with the flat-IR v2 freeze (see schema/spec/05-versioning.md). Ground truth: converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRDocument.kt (IRComponentSerializer) and IRPropertySerializer.kt.

components.description: Top-level component list. Always an ARRAY on the wire — the converter flattens the authoring-side name->component map in CssParsing.convertToIR (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/parsing/css/CssParsing.kt). May be empty for an empty input document.

component.description: One UI component. Serialized by IRComponentSerializer (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRDocument.kt): id/name/properties always present; selectors/media omitted when empty; children omitted when null or empty (hence minItems 1 where present); _text/_role omitted when null. _tag/_pseudo are reserved renderer-hint fields read by the runtimes (runtimes/web/src/core/ir/IRModels.ts) but not currently emitted by the converter — see schema/spec/04-metadata-fields.md.

id.description: Unique component-instance id. Converter-generated form is '<lowercased-name>-<NNN>' (CssParsing.convertToIR); extractor-derived children carry WPT ids like 'color-001__1__0'. Always non-empty on the wire.

name.description: Component type/class name (e.g. 'Button'). For children flattened from the input map, the map key becomes the name verbatim.

properties.description: Base properties. Always present, may be empty (e.g. every declared CSS property was invalid and dropped by PropertiesParser step 1).

selectors.description: Pseudo-class buckets (:hover etc.). Omitted entirely when empty, so if present it is non-empty.

media.description: Media-query buckets. Omitted entirely when empty, so if present it is non-empty.

children.description: Nested child components. ARRAY on the wire (map-in / array-out — see schema/spec/03-children.md); omitted when null or empty, so if present it is non-empty. flat-IR v2 (slot/placement) is a planned major version, not this contract.

_text.description: Renderer-only metadata (underscore rule, spec 04): element inner text carried from the WPT extractor. Omitted when null; empty string IS a legal emitted value ('extracted, was empty').

_tag.description: Renderer-only metadata: originating HTML tag, lowercase (e.g. 'ol', 'li'). Emitted by tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs for non-generic tags; consumed by the runtimes; currently DROPPED by the converter pipeline (known gap, spec 04).

_role.description: Renderer-only metadata: role marker. Only value emitted today is 'body-root' (tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs, forwarded by the converter). Open-ended string by design so future markers need no schema change.

_pseudo.description: Renderer-only metadata: synthetic ::before/::after/::marker nodes (runtimes/web/src/core/ir/IRModels.ts PseudoElements). Emitted by the WPT extractor, read by the web runtime, currently dropped by the converter (spec 04). Slot payloads are component-shaped but produced pre-converter, so they are validated permissively at v1.

property.description: The {type, data} property envelope (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRPropertySerializer.kt). 'type' is the IR type name with the 'Property' suffix stripped (e.g. 'PaddingTop', 'Color', 'Generic'). 'data' is deliberately unconstrained at v1: observed emitted kinds are object (most properties), raw number (e.g. percentage padding, numeric font-weight), raw string (keywords like 'auto', enum names like 'FLEX'), array (list-valued properties like TransitionDelay, BackgroundImage), and — inside objects — null and boolean leaves. Readers MUST tolerate unknown 'type' values by skipping the property with a logged warning (spec 05).

selector.description: IRSelector (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRDocument.kt): condition is the selector WITHOUT the leading colon (':hover' is stored as 'hover').

media.description: IRMedia (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRDocument.kt): query is the raw media query string, e.g. '(min-width: 768px)'.
